item.title: Top stocks to watch today: Coal India, Paytm, Ashoka Buildcon, Hexaware Tech, JK Cement, ACME Solar & 5 others in focus
item.description: Sensex and Nifty 50 may open lower on Friday, with Gift Nifty signalling a gap-down start, after both indices rallied to nine-month closing highs on Thursday. Investors will track corporate updates involving ACME Solar, Ashoka Buildcon, Coal India, Paytm and other companies.

item.title: Spectre of El Nino: CPI to average above 6% between November and March, says Elara's Garima Kapoor
item.description: India's retail inflation hit a two-year high of 6.1% in October, prompting Elara Securities economist Garima Kapoor to forecast above-6% inflation through March and two quarter-point interest rate hikes from the Reserve Bank of India.&nbsp;

item.title: Big dividends, thin profits? 7 stocks that are paying out more than they earn - CyberTech to UTI AMC
item.description: Several companies, including IL&amp;FS Investment Managers, CyberTech Systems and Premco Global, paid dividends exceeding their FY26 net profits. Their payout ratios reached 1,000%, 245.6% and 242.8%, respectively, highlighting why high dividend yields alone may not tell investors the full story.

item.title: Anthropic shares soar 21% in blockbuster debut: Can the AI giant justify its $1.8 trillion valuation?
item.description: Anthropic shares surged in their Nasdaq debut, reaching a valuation near $1.8 trillion and setting a record for the largest-ever public offering. The Claude maker raised $81.3 billion in its IPO and secured another $26 billion in a private placement.

item.title: Stock market outlook today,20 Nov:Sensex, Nifty prediction-DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
item.description: Indian markets may open lower on Friday as Asian shares fell amid a global technology selloff. The weak outlook follows Thursday’s strong rebound, when the Sensex rose 1.21% and the Nifty gained 1.14%, closing at nine-month highs.

Motilal Oswal’s Chandan Taparia suggested buying M&amp; M and Bank of Baroda, with specified targets and stop-losses.

item.description: The price of US sour oil has plunged, as a surge of oil from Venezuela, Canada and the Middle East gives refiners ample barrels to choose from.

item.description: A sell-off in Latin American currencies deepened Thursday, sending the Mexican peso to its lowest since June 2025 and forcing Brazil’s central bank to step in to prop up the real, amid the mounting prospect of more rate hikes in the US.

item.title: Goldman Sachs turns bullish on India stock market, upgrades rating to Overweight; sets Nifty target of 28,500
item.description: Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to Overweight and set a December 2027 Nifty 50 target of 28,500, citing expected earnings growth, resilient demand and renewed foreign investment.

item.title: Beyond BEL and HAL: L&T, Bharat Forge, BEML among 5 defence stocks that could benefit from proposed 20% capex boost
item.description: The Defence Ministry has sought a 20% increase in capital spending for 2027–28. HAL and BEL are expected to benefit most, while L&amp;T, BEML, Bharat Dynamics, Mazagon Dock, Bharat Forge and Tata Advanced Systems may also gain from increased orders.

item.title: Anthropic shares set for Nasdaq debut today; Wall Street brokerages see up to 87% upside from IPO price: Report
item.description: Four brokerages issued bullish ratings, with price targets implying potential gains of 51% to 87%, citing growth prospects and rising AI adoption.

item.title: Paytm, Pine Labs, MobiKwik shares tumble up to 9% on MDR delay concerns: Should investors stay away from fintech stocks?
item.description: Fintech stocks, including Paytm, Pine Labs and One MobiKwik, fell as much as 9% after reports that India may delay a planned fee on select high-value UPI payments. The proposed MDR, originally due on October 15, could be postponed while payment firms and retailers prepare for implementation.

item.title: Anthropic IPO listing today: How much listing gains can investors expect from the AI giant? Check details
item.description: Anthropic is preparing to debut on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, with grey-market trading suggesting shares could gain nearly 24% on listing. The company’s IPO has drawn strong demand as investors weigh continued enthusiasm for AI against concerns about technology-sector spending.

item.title: South Korea's KOSPI up 1.4%, Hang Seng edges higher as chip stocks recover. Can Anthropic's debut revive the AI trade?
item.description: Anthropic IPO: Asian markets were mixed on Thursday as a rebound in AI-related stocks lifted South Korea’s KOSPI 1.4%, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng 0.1% and Japan’s Nikkei 0.7%, while Taiwan’s Taiex fell 4.4%.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO latest GMP: Listing gain or long-term wealth? 5 reasons to bid despite weak subscription; review
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields’ ₹8,981.12 crore IPO is open from November 19 to 23, 2026. Anand Rathi recommends subscribing for the long term, citing market leadership, large reserves, low-cost operations and strong profitability.

item.title: Physicswallah share price up 6%: Motilal Oswal sees 56% upside on strong growth guidance - Should you buy? Target price
item.description: Physicswallah shares rose about 6.5% after the company set a target of 25% or higher revenue CAGR through FY30 and revenue of ₹90–100 billion. MOFSL maintained its Buy rating and ₹200 target price, implying nearly 56% upside.

item.title: Tata Tech shares jump 10% as company targets $1.3 billion revenue by FY30, bets on aerospace, industrial machinery
item.description: Tata Technologies shares rose 10% to a one-month high after the company set FY30 targets of $1.1–1.3 billion in revenue and margins above 20%. Its plans include expanding aerospace, industrial machinery and AI-enabled services.&nbsp;

item.title: This small-cap stock plunges 42% in 1 year, but Jefferies sees 53% upside - Is a big turnaround coming? Check target
item.description: Jefferies retained its Buy rating on CMS Info Systems and a ₹315 target, implying 53% upside. Services revenue and profitability strengthened in the September quarter, while product sales are expected to recover.&nbsp;

item.title: IREDA shares jump 11% to 4-month high: Is the renewable energy stock finally turning around after 6 months of losses?
item.description: IREDA shares surged 11% to a four-month high of ₹133.60, recovering their six-month losses as November gains reached 34%. Trading volumes spiked despite no clear immediate trigger.&nbsp;

item.title: Small-cap stock under ₹50: IT share jumps 8% after collaboration with Mahesh Babu Foundation; do you own?
item.description: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions shares rose nearly 8% intraday after the Hyderabad-based IT company signed a five-year collaboration agreement with Mahesh Babu Foundation.&nbsp;

item.title: Anthropic IPO breaks all records, even SpaceX! What $81.3 billion means for India's IT and AI stocks? Experts decode
item.description: Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO underscores the scale of investment flowing into AI. Indian technology companies could benefit from demand for cloud, data and AI services, but automation may pressure conventional IT work. Experts say investors should assess AI-related revenue, deal wins and margins.

item.title: Coal India vs NMDC vs MOIL: Which mining PSU stock deserves a place in your portfolio for long-term gains? Check target
item.description: Mining stocks showed mixed trading: Coal India and MOIL gained modestly, while NMDC slipped. Systematix sees growth potential across the companies, but flags operating costs and pricing pressures. Its recommendations are Buy for MOIL and NMDC and Hold for Coal India; MOIL offers the greatest upside.

item.title: MRF faces a long road to margin recovery as costs stay high
item.description: Commodity inflation is squeezing MRF’s margins, while slower revenue growth than peers and a weak rural-demand outlook cloud its earnings recovery.

item.title: ABB India’s margin recovery in spotlight amid record order inflow
item.description: Strong demand, led by the electrification business, is driving order inflows, but margin pressures and subdued industrial capex cloud the earnings outlook.
